data.name: Advaith
data.long_meaning: Advaith means 'non-dual'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'advaita', which signifies the ultimate reality that is beyond duality. In Hindu philosophy, it is the concept of oneness, representing the absolute truth and the ultimate goal of spiritual enlightenment.
